notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]-Patch Notes-[/b]
1. Fixed a bug that would keep house population when you sold it.
2. Fixed a bug that would keep the old workforce population tier when you upgraded its house to the next tier. When you upgrade a house to the next workforce tier you now properly lose the previous tiers population. This should correct the difficulty some as you will have to manage all tiers of the population.
3. Highlights now appear around newly unlocked buildings.
4. Fixed an issue with starting trade routes on the east or west island.
5. Cleaned up some text labels.

[b]-Coming Soon-[/b]
[b]Island fertilities[/b] are the next feature to be implemented. This will add a new level of challenge to the game in order to fully meet the needs of the 2nd tier of Workers. Along with this, it will also include some much needed polish to the current Trade Route system.

[b]Saves games[/b] - should be ready sometime this coming week.

[b]-Future Updates-[/b]
A more in-depth statistics panel that shows precisely the number of resources you are generating along with the current resource deductions.

[b]Goals / Quest Panel[/b] - To incentivize building certain buildings and to give rewards.

[b]Island Discoveries[/b] - Fog of war will soon cover the map and you will be required to discover the other islands via boats.

[b]-Looking into-[/b]
I've had a few requests for adding a few design features like the ability to plant and remove various trees or other landscape features.

----------
I would recommend not buying this game if you are looking for a complete bug-free experience. This is intended for people who are interested in beta testing the game and providing feedback.

Thank you!

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Difficulty
notes.notes:
[b]-Patch Notes-[/b]
1. Fixed an issue where the Valve Index and Vive Controllers were unable to consistently access the in-game instructions.
2. The number of resources the workforce require per cycle were incorrectly set to a much lower difficulty. This has been updated back to normal difficulty and you will now have to more actively manage resource production.
3. Potentially fixed the rotation of buildings on WMR controllers. 
[b]
-Quality of Life-[/b]
1. When you select a Building / Unit it will automatically rotate to the selection page.


[b]-Future Updates-[/b]
A more interactive tutorial should be out by the end of this weekend.

Island fertilities are the next feature to be implemented. This will add a new level of challenge to the game in order to fully meet the needs of the 2nd tier of Workers. Along with this, it will also include some much needed polish to the current Trade Route system.


[b]-Requests- [/b]
Saves games are currently not implemented. I'm considering implementing this sooner than I had originally planned as it has been a requested feature. I have a lot of backend work todo and didn't want to implement saves before I had a solid foundation as to not have to go back and rewrite save support for every small update.

----------
I would recommend not buying this game if you are looking for a complete bug-free experience. This is intended for people who are interested in beta testing the game and providing feedback.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello!

My thanks to every who has tried out the game and left feedback.

-Patch Notes-
1. Potentially fixed an issue where the main island would spawn floating trees and none of the other islands would spawn anything.

-Known Issues-
1. The initial launching of the game is a bit laggy/flickery while it builds the game map. I'm hoping to address this issue in a future update.

-Future Updates-
I'm currently working on a proper interactive tutorial that should be out by the end of the week. 

If you see any bugs please leave a community post so I can track down the issue. I'm currently solo developing this game on a Rift S and there might be some unaccounted for bugs involving different headsets.

Thank you!

notes.title: Coloniam Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thanks for taking the time to check out this early access game. This initial launch is for people who are interested in playtesting and providing suggestions for new content. I would suggest not buying this if you are looking for a bug-free feature-complete experience.

If you encounter any bugs or issues please feel free to make a community post about it.
